name: Auto Wave Level
description: One click: generates a random wave level and decorates it.

level-name.name: Level name
level-name.description: Prefix for generated levels. The seed is appended (GD limits names to 20 characters).

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Same seed + same settings = same level. 0 picks a random seed every time.

length.name: Length (seconds)
length.description: Length of the wave section at the chosen speed.

difficulty.name: Difficulty
difficulty.description: How narrow and how twisty the corridor is.

decoration.name: Decoration
decoration.description: None: bare corridor. Colors: palette, shaded walls and colour changes. Full: adds wall studs and beat pulses.

bpm.name: BPM
bpm.description: Timing of colour changes and pulses. Match it to your song.
